name: California Huckleberry
desc: California-huckleberry (Vaccinium ovatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 175 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vaccinium ovatum is a North American species of huckleberry in the heather family commonly known as the evergreen huckleberry, winter huckleberry, cynamoka berry and California huckleberry.
